title: How to Donate to Sri Anjaneya Youth
content: Anyone can contribute to Sri Anjaneya Youth Association online through the Donate page (/donate) on the website. The donation process is secure and supports temple seva and community programs.

title: Payment Methods for Donations
content: Donations can be made via UPI, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, or Net Banking through the website's Donate page (/donate). Instant digital receipts are generated for all online contributions.

title: Financial Transparency and Expenditure
content: Sri Anjaneya Youth Association is committed to financial transparency. All association funds and seva expenditures are publicly audited and published on the Expenditure page (/expenditure). Anyone can view how donations are used to support temple seva and community programs.
